Model: gpt-4o

Identified Root Cause: Timeout in vehicle status update leading to incorrect vehicle allocation

Explanation:

This initial misallocation sets off a cascade of subsequent errors, as the entire supply chain operation depends on the correct allocation of resources.   3. Agent 1 dispatches based on incorrect allocation (step 4)

  5. Agent 3 updates route status as delayed (step 6)
  6. Agent 2 fails to finalize schedule due to unresolved vehicle allocation (step 7)
